metadata.domain: Cathode Materials / Advanced Materials / Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 7→commercial in 2 years) and T02 (TRL 5→target in 3 years) are plausible given industry norms; T05 (TRL 4→deployable in 3 years) is moderately aggressive but not infeasible for sodium-ion battery anodes given current research momentum.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio mixes a near-market high-TRL technology (T01, TRL 7) with exploratory ones (T05 TRL 4, T02 TRL 5), but labeling T01 as 'Strategic' with maximum urgency scores contradicts a 기술선도 posture that should prioritize frontier R&D; the selection skews somewhat toward market-ready commercialization.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The roadmap provides no explicit evidence of competitor positioning, technology gap analysis, or differentiation rationale — technology choices appear driven by market opportunity scores alone rather than competitive landscape intelligence.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completing 1-2 years before boom is ideal; T01 completes 0.75yr late (post-boom), T05 completes 1.5yr late, and T02 completes 1yr late — all three technologies miss their boom windows rather than achieving pre-emptive completion, resulting in consistently post-boom delivery.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: All three technologies receive maximum market opportunity scores (5.0), suggesting market signal awareness, but there is no visible patent trend alignment rationale in the selection logic — convergence appears incidental rather than deliberately engineered.

strengths: Budget is fully utilized with zero violation, indicating disciplined resource allocation across the portfolio
TRL progression timelines are mostly realistic, with adequate development windows allocated per technology complexity
weaknesses: All three technologies complete after their respective market boom windows, undermining the preemptive advantage central to 기술선도 strategy
Inclusion of T01 (TRL 7, high-maturity) as a Strategic-tier investment weakens the frontier R&D orientation expected of a technology leadership posture
missing_technologies: Lithium-sulfur cathode materials (lower TRL, high patent activity, aligns with 기술선도 exploratory mandate)
Single-ion conducting solid electrolyte interface materials (enabling technology for T02, creates dependency-chain depth appropriate for leadership strategy)
investment_issues: T01 (TRL 7) receiving Strategic tier investment equivalent to T05 (TRL 4) misallocates frontier R&D budget toward a near-commercialization asset

T02 classified as High (not Strategic) despite being the most technically complex and strategically differentiated asset in the portfolio — tier assignment appears inconsistent with technology leadership priorities
timing_issues: 고니켈 양극 표면 코팅 completes 0.75yr after boom (2028-Q1 vs 2027-Q2) — should start earlier to achieve pre-boom completion
나트륨 이온 배터리 음극 completes 1.5yr after boom (2029-Q1 vs 2027-Q3) — the largest timing gap; earlier start or accelerated development needed
전체 고체전지 양극 소재 completes 1yr after boom (2030-Q1 vs 2029-Q1) — for 기술선도, completion should target 2028-Q1 to preempt market
